School of Tropical Medicine Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for School of Tropical Medicine Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the School of Tropical Medicine Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 27 August 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Senior Resident post at the School of Tropical Medicine.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a DM in Infectious Diseases or an MD in General Medicine, Paediatrics, Tropical Medicine, Respiratory Medicine, Geriatric Medicine, or Microbiology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Resident post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Resident post is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 1,00,000/- per month for DM holders and Rs. 85,000/- per month for MD holders.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. No online application is required.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the School of Tropical Medicine located?
faq.answer: The School of Tropical Medicine is located in Kolkata, West Bengal, with the pincode 700073.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview and Document Verification.
